translations.web: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
translations.bsb: Like a thorn that goes into the hand of a drunkard is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translations.kjv: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
translations.asv: As a thorn that goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, So is a parable in the mouth of fools.
